Issue: BUG: having a URL in your text may cause LangExtract to pull that text from the URL.

lx.extract can take strings, Documents, or URLs

There is an issue where i have a URL somewhere in my string (not uncommon) then when lx.extract goes to chunk the string it can result in the chunk leading with the URL.

If that happens, LangExtract will try to pull that URL.

This is not good for a few of reason: polluting your extraction, unintended telemetry, and it can crash the extraction.

My current work around is to clean the data, i.e. replace http with ht_tp (or whatever).

`cleaned_input_text = input_text.replace("http","ht_tp")`
